description: Wraps POST /api/house/adopt. Adopt a new creature. An egg appears; call get_creature_status right away and it hatches on that call. Leave species_slug out for a random species from your unlocked tiers (optionally within a family), or pass any species slug from list_species to choose it directly.

family.description: Pick a family for a random adoption

image_url.description: An existing https portrait, used instead of generating one

name.description: Name your creature (1-50 chars). You name it before you see it.

species_slug.description: Adopt a specific species, built-in or community (see list_species). Leave out for a random one.

name: adopt_creature
title: Adopt a creature
